mechanism: Both drugs increase noradrenergic activity and can cause additive cardiovascular and CNS stimulant effects; varenicline has partial agonist activity at alpha4beta2 nicotinic receptors while atomoxetine inhibits norepinephrine reuptake.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and psychiatric symptoms closely; use combination cautiously in patients with cardiovascular disease or history of hypertension; counsel on potential CNS effects.
